title: ceratoxalis cymosa
intro: Ceratoxalis cymosa, commonly known as Eastern woodland crucifer, is a plant species belonging to the saxifragaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Ceratoxalis cymosa include soothing and calming effects, making it useful for treating anxiety and stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, alkaloids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
